gloss: to become bloodshot; to become congested with blood

definitions.gloss: to become bloodshot; to become congested with blood
definitions.explanation: For blood to accumulate in a body part, causing redness, especially in the eyes.

examples.japanese: {目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}している。
{寝不足|ねぶそく}で{目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}してしまった。
examples.english: My eyes got bloodshot from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}の{季節|きせつ}になると{目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}して{痒|かゆ}くなる。
examples.english: During hay fever season, my eyes get bloodshot and itchy.

notes:
Composed of {充血|じゅうけつ} (congestion; hyperemia) + する. Most commonly used to describe bloodshot eyes, though medically it can refer to blood congestion in any body part. The noun {充血|じゅうけつ} is also common in medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}する: eyes become bloodshot
- {充血|じゅうけつ}した{目|め}: bloodshot eyes
- {充血|じゅうけつ}を{抑|おさ}える: to reduce redness/congestion
- {目薬|めぐすり}で{充血|じゅうけつ}を{取|と}る: to relieve bloodshot eyes with eye drops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- うっ{血|けつ}する: to become congested (blood pooling) — implies stagnation rather than active swelling; used for venous congestion
- {赤|あか}くなる: to turn red — general redness from any cause, not specifically blood congestion
